Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Class TcpClientEventAdapter

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.kristensoft.kdc.TcpClientEventAdapter
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    TcpClientEventHandler
    public abstract class TcpClientEventAdapter
extends Object
implements TcpClientEventHandler
    Provides a convenience adapter for receiving TcpClient events.

    This class provides empty implementations of all methods defined by TcpClientEventHandler, allowing subclasses to override only the event methods they are interested in.

    Author:
    Charles B. Kozoyed
    See Also:
    TcpClientEventHandler, TcpClient
